rationale: PyDESeq2 Wald with Control as reference, median-of-ratios inside the model, apeglm-style shrinkage, BH at 0.05, and a stated keep-inspect-report policy for the shallow sample_01 match the unpaired single-batch 6v6 design and the Python constraint. QC is complete (VST, PCA, distances, library sizes, detected genes) with an explicit non-removal rule. The prefilter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is the DESeq2 vignette convention and justified by group size, though on the stricter side of minimal, and it stacks with independent filtering. GSEA uses the full Wald-stat ranked list, names Hallmark 2026.1 and the 15-500 window, but the enrichment step itself never fixes a seed (only the report promises to record one), which weakens reproducibility of the permutation results.
